description: Strip HTML comments outside script/style blocks, conditional comments preserved.
Remove CSS rules whose selector names a class/id appearing nowhere else in the file (markup, attributes and script text all count as present).

Drop indentation and blank lines inside <style>, readable one-declaration-per-line form retained. Deliberately NOT the full-minification variant: run 1's SUMMARY flagged that as an owner decision not to be inherited across client sites.
Strip indentation, blank lines and whole-line // comments inside inline <script>. Line-oriented only, no intra-line changes.

Collapse markup indentation only where the whitespace run sits entirely between '>' and '<'. pre/textarea/style/script excluded; text-node inter-word spacing untouched. Run 1 predicted this would be the biggest lever.
